identification: John Campbell Pottery (Launceston, Tasmania) shield/leaf-shaped wall pocket, H 22 cm, mottled green and orange glaze over incised vein lines (stylised leaf, or possibly a moth/cicada with spread wings, the incised outline at the top centre is ambiguous). Back glazed amber-green, incised in script 'John Campbell / Launceston / Tas' plus a second underlined mark reading 'TAS' (probably a decorator's initials or a repeat of Tas). Hanging hole intact, no damage visible.
